notes.title: NEW RELEASE - HEX PICROSS
notes.notes:
Hi Players, 

Today we released a new game on Steam called Hex Picross

This game is a picross on a hexagonal grid with a beautiful minimol design and a relaxing sound enviroment.

More info and trailer on steam page store:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2113370/Hex_Picross/

notes.title: Gameplay remastered from your feedback
notes.notes:
Hey Guys,

Igor Sprovieri, developer of CANNON here

I'm grateful for your feedback, it was from it that we were able to change a lot of things in the game to improve the experience.

I released an update based on your feedback:

- Now the game is much faster
- The bugs have been fixed
- All cannons now have activation limit according to level

If you can play again and give me another feedback I would be extremely grateful.

Also tell me if the game speed is good or if it still needs to go faster.

If you have any more suggestions, say them here in the comments.
